label: Хороший / Плохой
description: Oppositional adjective drill: хороший vs плохой across gender, number, the suppletive comparatives лучше/хуже, and the adverbs хорошо/плохо.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine agreement. 1. 'Хороший' matches masculine 'человек'. 2. The ending is the soft masculine -ий after ш. 3. A clean positive starter.
Strategic focus: Masculine agreement, opposite pole. 1. 'Плохой' matches masculine 'день'. 2. The ending is the stressed hard masculine -ой. 3. Direct antonym of хороший.
Strategic focus: Feminine agreement. 1. 'Хорошая' takes the feminine ending -ая. 2. It agrees with 'идея'. 3. Compare masculine хороший to track the gender shift.
Strategic focus: Feminine agreement. 1. 'Плохая' takes the feminine ending -ая. 2. It agrees with 'погода'. 3. A common pairing and the antonym of хорошая.
Strategic focus: Neuter agreement, spelling rule. 1. 'Хорошее' agrees with neuter 'место'. 2. After ш the ending is -ее, not -ое. 3. This soft-spelling pattern is the trap.
Strategic focus: Neuter agreement, spelling rule. 1. 'Плохое' agrees with neuter 'настроение'. 2. After х the neuter ending is plain -ое. 3. Contrast with хорошее, where ш forces -ее.
Strategic focus: Plural agreement. 1. 'Хорошие' takes the plural ending -ие. 2. It agrees with 'люди' regardless of gender. 3. The -ие is soft after ш.

missions.phrase: У меня для тебя плохие новости.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural agreement, contrast. 1. 'Плохие' takes the plural ending -ие. 2. It agrees with 'новости'. 3. The pair хорошие/плохие is the full number contrast.
Strategic focus: Suppletive comparative. 1. 'Лучше' is the comparative of хороший. 2. It is suppletive, sharing no root with хороший. 3. Invariable, used here with 'так'.
Strategic focus: Suppletive comparative. 1. 'Хуже' is the comparative of плохой. 2. Like лучше it is suppletive, with no shared root. 3. Paired with 'стало' it marks worsening.

missions.phrase: Не волнуйся, у меня всё хорошо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Adverb form. 1. 'Хорошо' is the adverb of хороший, ending in -о. 2. It modifies the state, not a noun. 3. A fixed everyday phrase meaning all is well.

missions.phrase: Сегодня я чувствую себя очень плохо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Adverb form, contrast. 1. 'Плохо' is the adverb of плохой, ending in -о. 2. 'Очень' intensifies it. 3. The adverb antonym of хорошо.
